procedural_matters: ITA 13 was represented by Giulio Piccialli.
POL 26 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were wind around 15 knots with small chop.
Around 1 minute 15 seconds after the start of race 1, ITA 13 and POl 26 were sailing on a close-hauled course, with ITA 13 on starboard tack and POL 26 on port tack.
Both boats were sailing on converging courses.
At a distance of half a boat length from POL 26, ITA 13 tacked onto port.
If ITA 13 would have held her course contact would have occured between ITA 13’s bow and the starbord side of the hull of POL 26 amidships.
No contact occurred between the boats.
conclusions: POL 26 on port tack failed to keep clear of ITA 13 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
